trap.label: misto A e B
trap.wrong: If I would have studied, I am a pilot.
trap.right: If I had studied, I would be a pilot.
trap.why: O brasileiro mistura tempos. Misto A: if + had pp, would + base. Misto B: if + passado, would have + pp.

mcq.q: Misto A: If I had studied, I ___ a pilot now.
Misto B: If I were kind, I ___ helped.

fix.wrong: If I had studied, I would have a pilot now.
fix.right: If I had studied, I would be a pilot now.

fix.wrong: If I am kind, I would have helped.
fix.right: If I were kind, I would have helped.

rewrite.prompt: Misto A: “I didn’t study, so I am not a pilot.”
rewrite.answer: If I had studied, I would be a pilot.

rewrite.prompt: Misto B: “I am not kind, so I didn’t help.”
rewrite.answer: If I were kind, I would have helped.

rewrite.prompt: Use account for: “Oil is 30% of exports.”
